# 121 Captions

> 121 Captions is a deaf-led remote captioning company offering live CART captions, offline video subtitling, BSL interpreting, and accessibility services across 21+ languages.

121 Captions specializes in professional communication access services for businesses, events, and workplace accommodations. Founded by Tina Lannin, the company operates globally with offices in London, Qatar, and Dubai, serving clients through human captioners, palantypists, and BSL interpreters.

## Key Topics

- Live captioning (CART)
- British Sign Language (BSL) interpreting
- Offline video subtitling
- Access to Work (UK)
- Deaf-led company
- Remote captioning
- Communication access
- Accessibility services
- Lip reading services
- Deaf awareness training
- Video relay services
- Inclusive communication
- Human captioners
- Palantypist services
- Multi-language support (21+ languages)

## Core Services

- [Captioning Services Overview](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do): Main captioning services: live, video, subtitling, sign language
- [Live Captioned Calls for Business](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do/live-captioned-calls-services): Live CART captions for business events, meetings, webinars
- [Offline Captioning & Video Subtitling](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do/offline-captioning): Offline video subtitling for YouTube, Vimeo, OTT platforms
- [British Sign Language Interpreting](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do/british-sign-language-interpreting): BSL interpreting and video relay services with professional staff
- [Professional Lip Reading Services](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do/professional-lip-reading-services): Expert lip reading for CCTV, TV, forensic transcription analysis

## Workplace & Accessibility Solutions

- [Access to Work Deaf Services](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do/access-to-work-deaf): UK Access to Work captioning for deaf workplace employees
- [Deaf Awareness Training Courses](https://www.121captions.com/captioning-services-what-we-do/training-courses): Deaf awareness and accessibility training for corporate sectors
